notes.title: Update Notes For Jan 6
notes.notes:
Happy new year farmers! A few updates in Farm Empire to start the new year on:


 Old event empires can be re-opened at the cost of 10 crystal eggs.
 A new icon will tell you when a time warp in the shop will provide enough money for new milestones.


The next update will be an all new empire releasing on January 31.

notes.title: Update Notes For Dec 12
notes.notes: Fixed a problem with the xmas minigame sometimes presenting an empty menu.

notes.title: Update Notes For Dec 2
notes.notes: Fixed the menu getting stuck in the Christmas empire minigame

notes.title: Update Notes for July 25
notes.notes:
The next travel destination in Farm Empire has been decided, and this time the journey goes to beautiful Italy - available from July 31! 

The country offers all kinds of delicacies, such as pasta, pesto, and pizza - and if you are good at managing your empire, this can only result in one thing: money, money, and money! But don't just focus on these three things, as there are plenty of other raw materials that can be turned into delicious dishes and products. A true paradise for all food lovers. Molto delizioso!

This update simply prepares the release of the Italy empire, launching on July 31. No other changes included.

notes.title: Update Notes For July 10
notes.notes:
We added a new currency to Farm Empire: Crystal Eggs. Everything that used to cost money, now cost crystal eggs instead. The only thing you can purchase for money now, is crystal eggs. This greatly simplifies things on our end, when only selling one thing. Unlocking most of the new empires now cost crystal eggs, but otherwise everything else is priced similarly or lower. 

We also fixed a few minor bugs.

notes.title: Update Notes For Apr 30
notes.notes: Minor update to enable 1. May offer.

notes.title: Update Notes For Mar 3
notes.notes:
Easter Island is coming soon!

On March 27 we will release the Easter Island empire. This event empire will be available for one month, and features Easter themed assets like eggs and bunnies. You will also be able to paint Easter eggs for extra income, and as always these event empire are shorter than regular empires such that completion in a month is realistic.

Have fun on Easter Island!

notes.title: Update notes for September 11
notes.notes:
We have made overall adjustments to pricing.  Purchasing golden eggs now cost 50% less, and most things you can buy with golden eggs have slightly decreased in cost. A few things have increased in cost though.


 Huged price drops on airplanes, which now cost about half price.
 Buying workers without restarting now only costs 100 eggs.
 The six different time travels now cost 20 / 40 / 60 / 100 / 150 / 200 eggs.
 The yield of eggs from farms is lowered by approximately 40%.
 Purchase of upgrade now costs 40 / 60 / 80 eggs.
 Bug fixes.

Fixed text translation of auction buttons

notes.title: Update Notes For July 27
notes.notes: Fixed auctions not paying when timer runs out.

notes.title: Update Notes For July 26
notes.notes:
Fixed the shop.
 Selling assets on the auction simply earns you money now. Imagine you are selling overstocked assets instead. This is done to temove the slightly annoying re-purchase loop.

notes.title: Update Notes For July 25 - Auction house
notes.notes:
Added an Auction House mini-game. Sell your assets at the auction house, and earn extra money. The starting price is always what you paid, but you are able to push the price higher. Simply click the highest bid before time runs out, and keep doing so. You can do 3 auctions each day.
 The august task prizes and super prizes, will include shiny assets. Claim the prize, then the next asset you buy will be shiny.
 Expect a new empire to launch 31/7.

notes.title: Update Notes For May 15
notes.notes:
Less invitations to the shop and less purchase encouragement. Let us know if anything is still too pushy.
 Wishlist our new game Finding Fate to receive a bonus of 300 golden eggs. This bonus requires you to set your Steam profile to public, else we cannot see the wishlist data. You can revert to the previous settings when you have your bonus.

notes.title: Update notes for April 13
notes.notes:
Rare shiny assets with 25% higher earnings than regular assets.
 NOTE: The first asset you buy in this version will always be shiny!
 Stars can be exchanged for shiny assets.
 Travel time for all aircrafts decreased by approximately 50%.
 One travel can be skipped for free each 24 hours. 
 When an event empire expires (E.g. Easter Island), 1 golden egg is rewarded for each milestone percentage reached.
 Optional scientific notation. AA notation is still the standard notation style, and it's also still possible to use long number names.

notes.title: Update Notes For Apr 3

Minor fix to handling of empire resets.

notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 28
notes.notes:
Made it clearer that multipliers only work for current empire until it is reset (which is an optional action after 100% milestones is reached).
 Recommended route hint is not shown until after any empire has been reset. Requires expert knowledge to gain advantage of the hint, so no need to bother new players.
 Cost of recommended route hint is lowered to 10 eggs.
